hero.intro: A discreet, rigorous and considered legal practice. The firm advises individuals, families and businesses on the matters that matter most, with precision and discretion.

home.leadTitle: A considered approach to the practice of law
home.leadBody: The firm is built on clarity, preparation and integrity. Work is conducted in a measured manner, in the language and context of each client.
home.sectionTitle: A senior legal practice in Cairo and Giza
home.sectionBody: The firm is based in Egypt with offices in Dokki, Bab El Louk and Giza. It serves a national and international clientele across a broad range of legal matters.
